recognition_contract: all tracked blobs with known script suffix, Git100755 or CMakeLists.txt across each complete git tree; extensionless non-executable/shebang-only and embedded Markdown blocks not scanned, no universal language recognition or retirement decision inferred
limitations: Recognition is a full four-tree pass under the stated suffix/mode/CMake rules, not arbitrary language detection.

No activity or retirement permission follows from a suffix/content match.
